n01: Don't breathe. Don't blink. Whatever you do... don't make a sound.
n02: It's 11:48 PM, and you're exactly where you always are. Register three. FreshMart. The night shift.
n03: Everything here has a voice. The carts squeak, the machines nag, and the PA belongs to Gary.
n04: Then, like clockwork, your favorite regular walks in.
n05: But tonight, something's off. His skin is the wrong color.
n06: Two seconds. That's what he said. Now there's no pulse, no Tyler, and no way out.
n07: He's facing you, but he isn't looking at you. His eyes aren't following anything at all.
n08: He doesn't come for you. He goes for the noise. They hunt by sound.
n09: Okay. Think. Tyler's gone. The doors are sealed. Your phone is somewhere under the potato chips, ringing itself to death. Honestly, that's the least of your problems.
n10: Through the crack in the door, you watch them drift. A woman still holding her basket. A man in pajamas. They're not hunting. They're just... shopping. As if they forgot why they came.
n11: Probably a rat. You decide it's a rat.
n12: You don't sleep. You just wait, and the hours pass like days.
n13: Day two. No food. No water. No plan. Just one idea, and it's a terrible one: someone out there has to hear the PA.
n15: Every one of them heard that. Every. Single. One.
n16: Stupid. You just rang the loudest dinner bell in the world.
n17: They stop at the mouth of the aisle. Ten feet away, and they can't find you.
n18: Aisle 9. Canned goods, floor to ceiling. Turns out a wall of soup and beans is the best soundproofing in America.
n19: You laugh without a sound. Then you cry without one, too. Somehow, you're getting good at this.
n20: Day three. A scraped arm, a twisted ankle, and a store full of cans that all need a can opener.
n21: Then you spot it. Pop-top chili. Quiet, easy. What could go wrong?
n23: Run. Left. Not that way. Anywhere but there.
n24: Dead end. Nothing here but frosted glass and ice cream.
n25: And somehow, impossibly, he is. The cold is doing something to them.
n26: For the first time in three days, you don't have to run. You can just walk.
n27: Cold air, canned goods, and silence. It isn't much of a plan, but it's a start.
n28: Night falls on day three. You're still alive, and that's all you can say for yourself.
n29: Then, across the parking lot, a light flickers on. Twice. A pause. Twice again. Someone else is alive.
b01: Gary says he'll fix it when we get a budget. So, never.
b02: Cat food and a lottery ticket. You're my most predictable man, Mr. Halloran.
b03: Okay, okay, sit down. Tyler, can you grab some water?
b04: Tyler, I've got a man on the floor. Not now!
b05: Mr. Halloran? Can you hear me?
b08: Okay. Rational thinking. If I keep it quiet...
b10: Hello? My name is Bob. I'm at the FreshMart on Route 9. I'm locked inside, and I need help.
b14: Please be slow. Please be slow.
b15: Okay, new plan. We live here.
t01: Sorry! This cart's been squeaking since, like, forever.
t02: Bob, there are people in the parking lot. A lot of them, just standing there.
t03: Two seconds. I'm just gonna look.
h02: Bob, I don't feel so good. Everything's... ringing.
r01: Unexpected item in the bagging area.
x01: Let's go back to the start. Three nights ago, everything was normal. Boring, even.
x02: Click. The doors lock by themselves. The whole store is sealed shut, and you are stuck inside.
x03: That's not Mr. Halloran anymore. Not really.
x04: You need a place to hide. The stockroom has a door. For tonight, that's good enough.
x05: So you sneak out. Slow steps. No talking. Customer service is only two aisles away.
x06: Then the echo fades. And the whole store goes very, very quiet.
x07: You stay in Aisle 9 all night. The cans keep you hidden. But a hiding spot isn't food.
x08: Three days. Three rules. And every single rule cost you something.
x09: Who's out there? And are they friendly? Find out in Episode Two.
x10: Tyler went to look. He never came back. Now it's just you, and Mr. Halloran.
x11: You need a way out. Any way out. And the noise is right behind you.
x12: The noise brought them. But it might bring someone else, too.
